heading: INT. PENCIL FACTORY - OPEN-PLAN OFFICE - DAY

units.text: INT. PENCIL FACTORY - OPEN-PLAN OFFICE - DAY
A mezzanine office above the production floor.
Sawdust sifts through the floor grating.
Fifty identical desks, each with a cup of sharpened pencils.
A banner overhead reads: "WE'RE ALL POINT PEOPLE."
The air smells of cedar and stale coffee.
AUGUSTA MALOUF-PRIOR (50s, pearls, reading glasses on a chain) sits at the head of the room under a framed poster of a pencil.
Her desk is clear except for a single yellow No. 2.
At the next desk, QUENTIN BOWDEN-AKINTOLA (30s, short-sleeved dress shirt, tie with tiny pencils on it) types with two fingers.
Across the aisle, LORETTA GRUNDY (60s, cardigan, thermos shaped like a pencil) reads a printout without moving her lips.
At the back, in a corner no one has assigned, sits SIMEON PELL (20s, headphones around his neck, pencil behind each ear), the only person who has ever seen the factory floor in person.
Team, a quick update.
units.name: AUGUSTA

units.text: Nobody looks up.
She taps the pencil against the desk.
Management has decided to eliminate the red pencils.
units.name: AUGUSTA

units.text: All of them?
units.name: QUENTIN

units.text: All of them, Quentin.
units.name: AUGUSTA

units.text: Augusta, we've sold red pencils since 1952.
units.name: LORETTA

units.text: And we'll continue selling them until the stock runs out.
units.name: AUGUSTA

units.text: So we don't make them anymore.
units.name: SIMEON

units.text: Simeon, we make them differently.
units.name: AUGUSTA

units.text: How differently?
units.name: SIMEON

units.text: Without the red.
units.name: AUGUSTA

units.text: A silence.
Sawdust drifts.
Loretta turns a page.
Does that mean they're no longer red pencils?
units.name: QUENTIN

units.text: It means they're pencils.
units.name: AUGUSTA

units.text: They were always pencils.
units.name: LORETTA

units.text: Loretta, this is an exciting transition.
units.name: AUGUSTA

units.text: Augusta, I've seen four transitions. They all ended in lunch.
units.name: LORETTA

units.text: Simeon lifts a pencil from behind his ear and turns it in his fingers.
He looks at the tip.
Quentin resumes typing.
Do the blue ones stay?
units.name: SIMEON

units.text: The blue ones are under review.
units.name: AUGUSTA

units.text: And the green?
units.name: SIMEON

units.text: We don't discuss green.
units.name: AUGUSTA

units.text: What happened to green?
units.name: QUENTIN

units.text: Don't ask.
units.name: LORETTA

units.text: The banner overhead flaps in a draft from the floor.
Augusta sets the pencil down in the exact center of her desk, aligns it with the edge, and smiles at the room as though it had applauded.
Wonderful. Let's circle back after lunch.
units.name: AUGUSTA
